example.title: Crown Motel, Kings Beach (roadside motel with a crown-topped sign)

brief: A mid-century two-storey roadside motel: brown board siding and white trim, rows of doors off a railed upper gallery, a shallow red roof, a tall pylon sign crowned with a gold crown and a changeable-letter board, pine trees behind and cars parked at the doors. One photo. Older than 1970 (c. 1960s): the pylon-sign motel type is essentially pre-1970. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
